sited 2 times per year. I imported my data with 7 regional stratum, sites=

, and stratum+year and the observation level. I am interested in post-str=
atifying to determine how densities vary among the 7 strata across each o=
f the 4 years. This generates 28 different density estimates.=20

When I run the model it shows that I have 4,284 samples and that effort i=

messages.subject: Re: Post stratification
parts:
E.M.

Yes, I can duplicate what you report regarding the summary statistics in
the Distance output regarding the multiplication of number of sites and
number of total visits by the number of post-stratification visits. But
I believe the calculations of density/abundance are computed correctly.

If you do one or two hand calculations [D=(n*h(0))/(2*k*pi)] to check
that you are getting the correct densities for your stratum/year
combinations. Let me know if your hand calculations match the output.
